reports.title: © 2026 GOLUB CAPITAL LLC GOLUB CAPITAL BDC, INC. (Nasdaq : GBDC) EARNINGS PRESENTATION | QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2026

desk.headline: Adjusted NII $0.33 a share, in line; NAV down to $14.00, $0.33 payout held

numbers.eps_basis: adjusted net investment income per share

results: Total investment income fell 14% y/y to $186.8m as the portfolio shrank; adjusted NII was $0.33 a share, about flat on Q3.
Net realized and unrealized losses of $0.25 a share, mainly on non-accrual and restructured equity holdings, cut adjusted EPS to $0.08.
NAV per share fell to $14.00 from $14.25; two more companies went on non-accrual (now 1.6% of the portfolio at fair value).
New commitments were just $20.0m against $411.3m of exits; the company bought back 0.8m shares for $10.1m at about 89% of NAV.
A $0.33 base distribution was declared for the December quarter.

guidance.summary: Golub Capital BDC gives no earnings guidance. It declared a $0.33 quarterly base distribution, covered by adjusted NII, and kept its variable supplemental distribution policy.

watch: Further non-accruals and NAV marks on restructured holdings.
Whether the portfolio keeps shrinking as buybacks are favoured over new loans.
Coverage of the $0.33 distribution as borrowing costs rise.
